comment: The treatment hours, nine to five on the half hour - the owner's numbers, 25 Aug. THE canonical copy. nala-shared.js carries these for the staff pages and prearrival.html carries its own because a guest page never loads staff code; both copies are asserted against this file, the phone_cases.json pattern. The rules hold the same range in a regex. Change the hours HERE first and the suites name every copy that has not learned it. The durations live here on the same terms: an hour, an hour and a half, two hours, with the label the guest reads and the short form the tiles wear.
